Tier is derived from the artifact: stem/option/key-cell = A, passage prose = B, <surface re-author> = C (tools/check_consistency.py FINDING_REPAIR + REPAIR_TIER). `make repair-plan` prints the work order for both sections.

steps.audit: The script existed but its official parse was broken four ways, so --baseline printed numbers that contradicted official_calibration.md §2 and its own stated gate floors: section starts took the LAST 「問題N」 mention on the page (7/2023 measured 問題10 at 0 chars), passage markers had to own their line (「(2) 以下は、…メールである。」 dropped every passage of that section), item boundaries were any two-digit line (「14 時〜16 時」 cut the 問題14 flyer, so two sittings measured a 26-char 情報検索 section), and options were hunted in a joined string (the 「3」 of 「3月」 read as option 3). All four repaired: every sitting now yields 20 items, section lengths land within ~3% of the committed §2 table, and the option-ratio distribution reproduces the audit's own figures (median 1.25, p90 1.58).

The ≤1.30 clamp was correctly replaced by 1.65 WARN / 2.50 FAIL. Two corrections this pass: 問題14 is EXEMPT (its options are values and dates — official 12/2023 問70 prints 「3,500円」 beside a 25-character option, 4.17x, and 問題14's own range is 1.26-4.17 where 問題10-13's is 1.03-2.00), and the metric is printed length, not JP-only, which is what made numeric items look like 9x and 14x outliers. The clamp's breach rate is 34.3% of official items, not the audit's 40.5% — that figure came from a parse whose truncations inflated it.
